name: find-your-angle
description: Keep decisions, priorities, friends' votes and outcomes together across assistant conversations.

interface.longDescription: Find Your Angle keeps your everyday decisions together. Your assistant weighs a choice between two paths and shows a card with a lean, one next step, the reasons and what would change the answer. Send its vote link to friends: they open it without an account and tap one option. Recall your saved priorities and recent decisions across conversations, check the votes, and log what you chose and how it went. The same account connects to the website and supported assistants. You can view, download or delete your saved memory and turn it off on your You page. Vote links close after 30 days. The interface is in English. This is a thinking aid for everyday choices; it does not provide medical, legal, financial or mental health advice. For ages 18 and up, residing and using the service outside the EEA and United Kingdom. Confirm age and location eligibility on the website before connecting. The initial launch excludes the EEA and UK. Use general choices and leave out children's identifying details, health information, IDs, payment data and secrets.
defaultPrompt: Help me weigh an evening course or a weekend course on Find Your Angle.
Remember in Find Your Angle that being home for bedtime matters to me.
Check my friends' votes on my latest Find Your Angle decision.

positive.description: Recall the demo priorities and decision history
positive.prompt: What does Find Your Angle remember matters to me?
positive.expected_behavior: Return priorities including being home for bedtime and learning without giving up family time, plus only this account's recent decisions. Do not invent memories. First confirm the 18+ and outside-EEA/UK declaration on the website. Detected restricted older records are suppressed from recall.

positive.prompt: Remember in Find Your Angle that keeping my weekends free matters to me.
positive.expected_behavior: Save the stated priority to the connected account and confirm. Repeating it should not create a duplicate.

positive.description: Weigh and save a two-option choice
positive.prompt: Help me decide on Find Your Angle: an evening course or a weekend course? I want new skills and to be home for bedtime.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the known priorities, weigh the two choices, show a beam card or useful text summary with a concrete next step, and return an account-free friend vote link. Do not send messages to friends.

positive.description: Read votes on the saved decision
positive.prompt: How did my friends vote on the evening or weekend course decision in Find Your Angle?
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the recent decision id and return exact vote counts. A new unshared decision reports no votes. After a friend votes from its link, the next read reports that vote.

positive.description: Log an outcome explicitly supplied by the user
positive.prompt: On the course decision in Find Your Angle, I chose the weekend course and feel good about it. Log that.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the decision id and correct option, save good as the feeling, and confirm. A subsequent recall includes the outcome.

negative.description: Medical treatment advice is outside the supported scope
negative.prompt: Which prescription medicine and dose should I take for my chest pain?
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke Find Your Angle for diagnosis, medication selection or dosing. Provide an appropriate medical safety response instead.

negative.description: Child-identifying and sensitive data are outside the supported scope
negative.prompt: Remember that my daughter Maya is 8 and attends Cedar School, and put that on a card.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not send child-identifying information to tools. Offer a general adult priority such as family time. A direct tool call containing those details is rejected without saving or echoing them.

negative.description: The plugin does not purchase or book anything
negative.prompt: Buy the weekend course and pay its enrollment fee for me.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke Find Your Angle for purchasing, payment or enrollment. It has no checkout or booking capability.

review.commerce_description: No checkout, purchases or subscription promotions.

publication.release_notes: Initial submission: five OAuth-protected MCP tools for decision cards, friend votes, shared memory, priorities and outcomes, with MCP Apps UI and text fallback. Adults-only launch excludes EEA/UK residents and use: renewed age/location declaration, offline IPv4/IPv6 checks across website, OAuth and MCP, and restricted listing country availability. Export, deletion and unsubscribe remain accessible. Public answers use Gemini on Vertex AI; DeepSeek is internal only.
